brief: A multi-tenant SaaS for a company's PMO. It answers one question: what evidence shows an employee can work independently, and who acts next? The mark should feel calm, credible and alive, and stay simple enough to animate.
criteria: Success: a green twig that reaches, three leaves, no detail, legible at 16 px, works in one colour and reversed, built from parts that can be animated.

concepts.name: Reach
concepts.idea: A small shoot leaning forward, its tip leaf reaching up and out: a new team member taking hold and growing towards independence.
rationale: Three leaves that alternate and grow towards the tip: progress without a chart
One stem and three leaves, built as parts: the stem draws on, each leaf grows from its joint
A heavier small-size cut keeps the twig readable in a 16 px browser tab

recommendation: Reach: the clearest sense of growth and reaching, the strongest at small sizes, and ready for motion.
next_steps: Roll the mark out in the app (done: sidebar, site header, login, browser tab)
Decide whether the Orchid purple accent stays next to the green mark
Use graft-animated.svg for the sign-in and loading moments
